pages.title: Start a sleep
pages.lead: Time a nap or a night. You and Jen both see it, live.

cols.caption: Tick **Sleep** on the new blank card.
cols.note: Already ticked a feed or nappy on that card? Sleep starts its own new card.

cols.title: What it does
bullets: Times a nap or a night, start to finish.
Jen sees it on her phone, live, and can pause or stop it too.
Started late, stopped too soon, or a mistake? That's all covered in this guide.

cols.caption: The timer runs. Lock your phone if you like: it stays right.

pages.title: Pause, resume, stop
pages.lead: Stop works at any time. Pause needs a minute of sleep first.

cols.note: The timer holds while baby is awake.

cols.caption: Saved. A finished sleep is read-only. Tap **2 pauses** to see each one. Stopped too soon? Tap **Reopen sleep**.

cols.title: Good to know
bullets: Only time asleep is counted, not time awake while paused.
Paused for 3 hours? The sleep closes itself at the time baby woke, and can't be reopened.
Use **Stop** when baby is up for the day or the night. Use **Pause** for a short wake.

pages.title: Started late? Fix the time
pages.lead: Forgot to tap when baby dropped off? Set the real time. **Woke earlier?** does the same for waking up.

cols.title: Pick a time
bullets: Your phone's own clock opens. Choose the time and confirm. It saves right away.
A time **more than 3 hours ago** asks you to confirm first (**Save anyway**).
A time that overlaps another sleep is refused, and the card says why.

legend: **Pick a time**: use your phone's clock.
Tap **Set** (or tap the highlighted time). Done.

pages.title: Stopped by accident?
pages.lead: A quick stop asks first. A finished sleep can be reopened for a while, and a pause you didn't mean can be removed.

cols.caption: **Keep sleeping** carries on. **Stop and save** keeps it. **Discard sleep** deletes it (you can restore it).

cols.title: When you can reopen a sleep
bullets: Only while it's the **latest** sleep. Once a new one starts, the old one is locked.
Not after it closed itself from 3 hours paused.
It goes back to paused, in the same place in your list.

cols.caption: **Reopen sleep**, tap **Remove** next to that pause, then **Stop Sleep**. It ends at the same wake time.
cols.note: Only while a sleep is open. A finished sleep is read-only.

pages.title: Edit, delete, restore
pages.lead: Fix the details, or delete a sleep and bring it back within 7 days.

legend: Who's logging it. Tap the name to switch.

cols.caption: **Timeline**, then **Recently Deleted**, then **Restore**. Kept for 7 days.

pages.title: Two phones, one sleep
pages.lead: You and Jen see the same sleep, live. Either of you can pause, resume or stop it.

cols.caption: Jen sees the same card and the same timer.
The first tap wins. The other phone says what happened, and its card is already up to date.

cols.title: Good to know
bullets: Times follow your phone's clock and time zone. The timer uses the server's clock, so a wrong phone clock can't throw it off.
Sleeps don't show in Timeline or Reports yet.
On iPad, sleep cards sit above the table, and Sleep has its own column.
